subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but the target-repo attempts are closed unmerged while the remaining fork candidates are conflicting, so a maintainer should choose the fix path before another automated branch is created.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Use the existing PRs as source context, but land a clean Feishu-plugin fix with tests and live Feishu proof on a new or maintainer-owned branch.

options.title: Refresh one fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better open fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and real Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new fix lane until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Use the existing PRs as source context, but land a clean Feishu-plugin fix with tests and live Feishu proof on a new or maintainer-owned branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path and plugin-runtime history makes this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the landing path.
